title.en: Kokoro ga Yomeru Oujo wa Konyakusha no Dekiai ni Kizukanai
Shiitagerareta Tsuihou Oujo wa, Tensei shita Densetsu no Majo deshita
Ikenie to shite Surerareta no de, Henkyou Hakke ni Jibun wo Urimasu
Reikoku Koutei wa Hitojichi Oujo wo Dekiai-chuu
Kakan no Oukoku no Hanagirai Hime
Ouji, Konyaku Haki Shita no wa Sochira na no de, Kowai Kao de Kocchi Niramanaide kudasai
Tensei Oujo wa Osananajimi no Dekiai Houimou kara Nigedashitai - Zense de Furareta no wa Watashi yo ne!?
Imokusa Reijou desu ga Akuyaku Reisoku wo Tasuketara Kiniiraremashita
Sue Oujo no Koshire - Sono Kage de Hamerare, Tsukai Suterareta Oujo no Kagemusha no Shoujo ga Jibun no Shiawase wo Tsukamu made
Guman Oujo deshita ga Kokoro wo Irekaeta no de Mou Warui Koto wa shimasen, Tabun
Tashikani Watashi wa, Oyome-san ga Hoshii to Iimashita.
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Aru Hi, Mukuchi na Konyakusha no Kanjou ga Wakaru you ni narimashita
Akuyaku no Oujo ni Tensei Shitakedo, Kakushi Chara ga Kakuretenai
Kono Tabi, Reikoku Koushaku-sama no Hanayome ni Erabaremashita - Suterare Oujo no Danna-sama wa Dekiai ga Kakusenai!?
